title: Plastic with Issues
text: Plastic with Issues. This is not the best juicer in the world. First, it is plastic. Second, your are the power. Juicing is tough business. Anything really hard isn’t great in this thing. Basically, anything you could juice by hand, you can juice in here. Apples will juice better in here if you peel them. Forget juicing beets. Greens don’t juice well, either. This juicer just isn’t good for me. I’m not a fan. Does it work on some things in some circumstances? Yes. Is it great for everything? No.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Professional Hand Crank Manual Juicer, White/Orange
features: This hand operated juicer makes it quick and simple to make refreshing, nutrient rich juices from your favorite fruits and vegetables
Included with the juicer is a plunger, measuring cup with straining lid, and a juice cup
Strong, non-slip suction base prevents the juicer from slipping or moving during use
Use anywhere, no electricity needed; portable, manual and extremely easy to use and clean
description: The Farberware professional manual juice press is prefect for those who live an active and healthy lifestyle. This sturdy, single auger juice press is perfect for making juice out of a wide variety of fruits, vegetables and even wheat grass. It is easy to use. Simply attached the juicer to the counter using the strong, suctioned base. Add your fruits and vegetables into the juicer then turn the easy-to-use hand crank. Instantly turning your fruits and vegetables into a tasty and healthy beverage! this juicer creates a smooth, enjoyable Texture. With the manual design, you don't have to worry about having electricity -you can juice anywhere. Perfect for rv'ing, and camping. All removable parts are dishwasher safe, wipe down the juicer with a damp cloth as needed.
